name: Miyasaka Minori
source:
Minori is [url=/c57349]Arisa[/url]'s youngest daughter and  [url=/c79090]Takuya[/url]'s younger sister. She is a high school student where she is very popular because she is known as very hardworking, kind and cute. She is a great food lover, and the dishes prepared by her mother and brother are her favourites. She feels very lucky to have Takuya as her older brother, because he is always extremely kind to her, she admires him very much. She is quite adorable and calm at home, but she doesn't pay much attention to what she does, almost always showing her panties unintentionally.  

Recently, she started dating a [url=/c79089]boy[/url] from her high school, but her romance with him is quite platonic. Arisa often annoys her about her relationship because she knows that talking about it embarrasses her daughter and makes her nervous.
